platform_volume_24h.scope: Entire Hyperliquid platform (repeated in each builder profile)
platform_volume_24h.limitation: This is not an individual wallet 30-day volume; it cannot be used as the Q2 denominator and should not be summed across profiles.

selection: Non-empty public refCode and strictly over $1m 30-day leaderboard volume
grouping: xUserId normalized to lowercase, else builder address
attribution_note: Builder volume / volume across selected builders is an upper-bound proxy; direct and excluded-builder volume is unobserved; full-account perpPnl is not attributable to a builder.
limitations: Account-wide perpPnl appears identically across builder files
Cross-company wallets make summed company PnL non-unique
Leaderboard and wallet files have different snapshot/aggregation timing
Wallet-level volume covers only observed selected builders
Product type does not demonstrate causation
Top-10 exclusion adjusts volume using routed wallet volume, an approximation

volume_comparison.source: HyperTracker 30d builder-wallet snapshot 2026-10-30; public Hyperliquid userFillsByTime historical execution fills
volume_comparison.api_request: Paginated userFillsByTime, startTime 30 days before source download timestamp, endTime at source download timestamp; aggregateByTime=false
volume_comparison.source_download_timezone_assumption: UTC (downloaded strings do not specify offset)
volume_comparison.method: Returned trade notional is sum(px * sz) across paginated historical fills, treated as USD equivalent; spot quote conversion is not independently verified; selected volume is sum of wallet builder-routed volume over 125 eligible builder codes. Inclusive timestamp boundaries are deduplicated. Responses that remain unpageable, inverted by more than 1%, or fail are excluded.
volume_comparison.selection: 10 addresses spread across each of 10 overlapping-wallet volume deciles; 5 per single-builder decile; 25 highest-volume overlap wallets; middle-volume wallet for each of the 30 largest leaderboard codes. Duplicates queried once.
volume_comparison.privacy: Only aggregates; addresses and individual trade observations are stored under private .cache and excluded from submission.
caveats: This is a deliberately stratified sample, not an estimate for all wallets or all company volume.
Fills cover available trading across direct access and builders, without execution-builder identifiers; full exchange-history coverage is unverified.
Some cached responses exceed the documented 10,000-fill history restriction; this discrepancy does not establish complete coverage.
Near-snapshot source end times, UTC assumption and data vendor scope can still cause small inconsistencies.

2,000 fills is a per-request limit; the script paginates by fill timestamp. The public API also documents a 10,000-most-recent-fills history restriction, so older trades may not always be recoverable. We cannot independently certify complete exchange history.
Volume share does not attribute wallet-wide profit or loss to a builder.
